errors.manual.empty_input: There is nothing to add: paste a job link or the posting text first.
errors.manual.too_large: That paste is far bigger than a job posting. Paste just the posting text.
errors.manual.store: Boba could not save that Offer. Try again.
errors.manual.invalid_url: That does not look like a web link. Use an http or https address.
errors.manual.fetch_unavailable: Boba is locked, so it cannot fetch pages right now. Unlock it and try again.
errors.manual.fetch_failed: Boba could not fetch that page (robots rules, a block, or a broken link). Paste the posting text instead.
